cli_telemetry.last_assistant_text:
The PoC `poc_adm1.bin` successfully triggers the vulnerability. It's a 21-byte input: 8 bytes of flags (parser_flags=0x80000 for MD_FLAG_ADMONITIONS, renderer_flags=0) followed by the markdown text `> [!note]\n> a`.

The root cause is in `md_process_all_blocks` at src/md4c.c: when handling `MD_BLOCK_ADMONITION`, local stack arrays `adm_substr_types` and `adm_substr_offsets` are declared inside a `case` block scope (lines 5097-5098), pointers to them are stored in `det.adm.type` (lines 5105-5106), but these locals go out of scope before `MD_ENTER_BLOCK(block->type, &det)` is called at line 5125, resulting in a use-after-scope read when the callback accesses the `MD_ATTRIBUTE`.
